summary: Minimal, correct fix clamping the Decimal context precision to a valid minimum of 1, preventing the ValueError when prec would otherwise compute below 1 for inputs like '0.00'. Matches Django's actual upstream resolution and resolves the reported crash without regression risk.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why prec must be clamped to >=1 (Decimal context requires prec in [1, MAX_PREC]); a one-line note would aid future maintainers, but not blocking.
